integrity.computational_role: Symbolic checks verify coefficients only and are not used as a substitute for the proof.
integrity.proof_basis: Analytic recurrence and occupation-time argument; exact return-map algebra checked symbolically.
integrity.source_access: Relevant sections of the two primary papers were read; the full 2011 background article was not required for the proof.

scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a one-dimensional positive return coordinate with a superattracting power-law return map.
Only algebraic and logarithmic cycle-duration laws are covered.
The outside-time contribution per cycle must converge to a positive constant and be bounded on partial cycles.
The application to the piecewise-smooth example applies to trajectories with y>0 and infinitely many section returns; boundary trajectories are excluded.
No uniform finite-time error estimate or claim about arbitrary statistical attractors is made.
title: A Two-Regime Occupation Law for Superattracting Return Flows
